field_edits.updated_text: A benign-appearing vertebral hemangioma is noted within the L2 vertebral body. Focal marrow/soft-tissue edema-like signal involving the anterior adjacent endplate at L2-L3 and the spinous process of L4 is present. No acute fracture.
Straightening of the normal lumbar lordosis is noted. No spondylolisthesis.
Multilevel degenerative spondylotic changes are seen with marginal osteophyte formation and multilevel intervertebral disc desiccation and bulging.
Mild diffuse disc bulge is noted. No significant central canal stenosis or neural foraminal compromise.
Diffuse disc bulge with bilateral neural foraminal narrowing. Mild degenerative endplate changes. Focal marrow/soft-tissue edema-like signal involving the anterior adjacent endplate.
Diffuse disc bulge with bilateral foraminal extension causing bilateral neural foraminal narrowing and crowding/impingement of the exiting nerve roots.
Diffuse disc bulge with bilateral neural foraminal narrowing and mild central canal stenosis (AP diameter ~9.6 mm). Impingement of bilateral exiting nerve roots.

Diffuse disc bulge with bilateral foraminal extension causing bilateral neural foraminal narrowing and impingement of the exiting nerve roots. Central canal AP diameter ~12 mm without significant focal compression of the cauda equina.

impression:
1. Straightening of lumbar lordosis.
2. Multilevel degenerative spondylotic changes with marginal osteophytes and disc desiccation/bulging.
3. Vertebral hemangioma in L2.
4. L1-L2 mild diffuse disc bulge without significant canal or foraminal stenosis.
5. L2-L3 diffuse disc bulge with bilateral foraminal narrowing, mild degenerative endplate changes, and focal edema-like signal in the anterior adjacent endplate.
6. L3-L4 bilateral neural foraminal narrowing with impingement of bilateral exiting nerve roots.
7. L4-L5 disc bulge with bilateral foraminal narrowing, mild central canal stenosis (AP ~9.6 mm), and impingement of bilateral exiting nerve roots.
8. L5-S1 disc bulge with bilateral foraminal narrowing, impingement of exiting nerve roots, and central canal AP diameter ~12 mm without focal cauda equina compression.
9. Focal marrow/soft-tissue edema-like signal involving the spinous process of L4.
